name: Meeting Notes Summarizer
purpose: Summarize internal meeting recordings into notes and action items

value.primary_kpi: Time managers spend writing meeting notes
value.guardrail_metric: Fewer than 1 in 10 summaries need a correction for missing or wrong action items

rationale: Internal meeting content only, HR and legal meetings excluded. Managers check every summary before sharing, and errors are easy to correct.

name: Customer Support AI Assistant
purpose: Answer customer questions and assist with support tickets

value.guardrail_metric: Customer satisfaction (CSAT) stays at or above 4.2/5; reopened tickets stay under 8%

rationale: Reads customer account details and answers customers directly. Agents review refunds and escalations, so autonomy is limited.

name: AI Resume Screening Assistant
purpose: Rank job applications against role requirements to create a shortlist for recruiters

value.primary_kpi: Time to create a qualified shortlist
value.guardrail_metric: Shortlist pass rates stay similar across gender and age groups; recruiter override rate under 15%

rationale: Ranks real job applicants using personal data, and errors could unfairly affect people's access to jobs. Employment decisions are regulated in many places.
